thread:
Nora: Tango (the office ferret) executed a precision sticky-note heist during standup. stole the sprint goals note. pic: https://i.imgur.com/ferretHeist.jpg
Ben: Nooooo my OKR sticky. Tango is a threat model now. :scream_cat:
Carla: This is peak ferret behavior. Hes clearly auditioning for stealth ops.
Nora: He then rolled into a cardboard tube like nothing happened. (gif attached)
ops-bot: FYI: building camera 4 recorded a 9s clip of Tango at 10:12am. Clip ID: cam4-3125-10.
Ben: We should award him SPRINT MVP. Who approves?
Carla: I motion we make a tiny sash that says "Sprint MVP" and a tiny clipboard.
Nora: Vote: sash or sticky crown? (reply with sash/crown)
Ben: sash
Carla: crown
Nora: tally: sash 1, crown 1. Tie. Flip a coin? :coin:
Ben: coin: crown it is.
office-bot: Note: please do not attach items to animals. Consider a removable sash for photos only. Facilities notified about safe props.
Nora: Update: Tango returned the note partially chewed. Action items: 1) Recreate sprint goals, 2) order tiny crown for photo ops.
Carla: Also: mandatory Tango cameo in the all-hands intro slide?
Ben: +1. He can lead the applause. :clap:
Nora: Closing note: if anyone finds small socks missing, Tango is the prime suspect.
